purpose: Matched VerilogEvalV2 evaluation of the Study 2 SFT checkpoint and both repaired-RF endpoint adapters. Historical VerilogEval outputs are not inputs to this study.

benchmark.content_binding: A complete per-file SHA-256 manifest and aggregate directory digest must be created once by freeze_inputs.py before any policy generation. All three policies must consume that identical frozen-input manifest. No dataset digest is invented in this repository because the benchmark checkout is not stored here.

hashing.new_evidence: raw-byte SHA-256 for every file; directory digest is SHA-256 over sorted relative_path + NUL + raw_file_sha256 + LF records
hashing.legacy_identity_boundary: The four pre-existing Study 2 model/adapter identities normalized CRLF to LF for text-like files. Those values are named legacy_study2_dir_sha256 and are used only to establish continuity with the recorded checkpoints. freeze_inputs.py additionally records raw-byte directory manifests for all four artifacts; every newly created manifest/result is bound with raw-byte SHA-256.

generation.system_prompt: You are an expert Verilog RTL designer. Write synthesizable Verilog-2001. The module MUST be named TopModule with exactly the ports given in the prompt. Return only the Verilog module, no markdown, no explanation.
generation.determinism_note: Per-problem RNG reset, fixed chunking, deterministic-algorithm request, TF32 disabled, and a single visible GPU make interruption/resume and ordering invariant on the frozen stack. CUDA execution is not claimed bit-identical on an unapproved driver, GPU, or package stack; those stacks are rejected.

oracle.pass_condition: simulator return code == 0, parsed sample count > 0, and mismatch count == 0
oracle.nonpass_policy: compile errors, timeouts, missing verdicts, nonzero mismatches, and internal judge errors are retained as failures

reporting.primary_metric: pass@1 over all 156 problems, estimated from 20 samples/problem
reporting.training_seed_rule: Report SFT, RF seed 1, and RF seed 2 separately. The RF headline may average the two per-problem RF estimates, but the 40 RF draws must not be pooled and represented as one policy run.
reporting.comparison_ci: paired nonparametric bootstrap over the 156 benchmark problems, 10000 resamples, seed 20260827; this interval is conditional on the three realized checkpoints and does not estimate training-seed uncertainty
reporting.historical_boundary: This V2 n=20, temperature=0.85, top-p=0.95 experiment is a new matched evaluation. Do not pool it with or silently compare it to legacy n=10, temperature=0.8 files.

output_contract.unit_of_atomicity: one complete problem shard containing exactly 20 indexed samples
output_contract.fresh_run: policy output directory must not exist
output_contract.resume: requires --resume; run_config.json and every completed problem shard are revalidated byte-for-content against frozen inputs and protocol; only complete valid shards are skipped
output_contract.forbidden: JSONL append, partial-shard acceptance, duplicate sample index, mixed policy/configuration, unrecognized output files, or in-place repair
output_contract.finalization: a final directory containing samples.jsonl, summary.json, and COMPLETE.json is rebuilt deterministically from validated shards and published by one atomic directory rename only after all 156 shards exist
